content.short: Sanctum is a leading liquid staking aggregator on Solana that provides unified liquidity for LSTs.
content.description: Sanctum is a premier decentralized finance protocol natively built on the Solana blockchain, designed to maximize the utility and liquidity of liquid staking tokens (LSTs). By providing a unified liquidity layer and an advanced 'infinity' pool, Sanctum ensures that users can seamlessly swap between different LSTs with zero slippage and high capital efficiency. The platform features an intuitive interface for discovering and managing staked assets, empowering users to earn maximized validator rewards while maintaining full asset liquidity. Sanctum focuses on fostering a vibrant and interconnected staking ecosystem, serving as a critical infrastructure layer for decentralized asset management on the rapidly expanding Solana network.
content.meta: Sanctum provides unified liquidity for Solana LSTs, offering zero-slippage swaps and optimized yield for liquid staked assets.
